notes: This portable scenario is limited to transfer of the standard HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject attribute by ordinary Attribute Ownership Acquisition and Divestiture If Wanted, followed by failed deletion by the former holder and successful deletion by the new holder. It uses one adapter-supplied object class and ordinary attribute, and makes no claim about other divestiture forms, timestamped deletion, DDM, save/restore, interoperability, or conformance.

requirements.statement: A joined federate acquires the standard HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject attribute through the published object class, the previous holder ceases to own that attribute, deletion by the former holder is rejected with DeletePrivilegeNotHeld, and deletion by the new holder is accepted.
